content: Root cause: The bug was caused by the digest value being stored in the transformation context (`safexcel_ahash_ctx`), which was inadvertently overwritten when HMAC initialization functions were called. This happened because those HMAC init functions invoked the SHA initialization functions, which reset the digest value. As a result, under heavy load, a small percentage of HMAC computations produced incorrect results due to the unintended resetting of the digest. Moving the digest to the request context (`safexcel_ahash_req`) ensured that it would not be affected by simultaneous context operations, thus preventing this issue.
